common.name: Panlight Salt
common.description: Coarse grey salt scraped from the drying pans. It crusts on your fingers and does not wash off.

uncommon.name: Brinewort
uncommon.description: A fleshy, bitter weed that grows where the tide leaves the pans. Boiled long enough, it is almost food.

rare.name: Tidemark Crystal
rare.description: A pale crystal grown in the flooded undercroft. It holds a faint light long after the lamp is gone.

drop.name: Skitter Chitin
drop.description: Plates of salt-hardened shell pried from a skitterer's back. They flex without cracking.

trophy.name: Skitterer Eyestalk
trophy.description: A dried eyestalk on a crust of salt. Pan workers pay a little for them, and do not say why.

gear.name: Crustshell Greaves
gear.description: Leggings of cured hide sewn with shell plates. They creak when you kneel.

drop.name: Sentinel Rivet
drop.description: A thumb-thick rivet of tide-black iron, still warm from whatever moved the sentinel.

trophy.name: Tide Bell Clapper
trophy.description: The small bronze clapper that rang inside a sentinel's chest. It rings once more if you shake it.

gear.name: Sentinel Maul
gear.description: A heavy head of riveted iron on a salt-pale haft. It was built to stop the tide, and it nearly does.

first.name: Rivetbound Mace
first.description: A mace headed with sentinel rivets and wrapped in chitin. It lands with a dull, final sound.

second.name: Chitin Jerkin
second.description: A jerkin of overlapping skitter shell, salted until it no longer smells. Mostly.

third.name: Brinewort Broth
third.description: A grey broth of brinewort and pan salt. It warms you, which is the kindest thing it does.
